  PROBLEM: The changelog sentence "When the before or after state cannot be read, or the result's status is anything other than `pass` (`fail`, `unverified` or `skipped`), the gate behaves as before." is wrong. The new guard at scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:839-841 (`[ "${rpg_pre_repair_status}" = pass ] && [ "${rpg_pre_repair_failures}" = 0 ]`) fires only for `pass`. On the base branch, the removed #9728 guard reverted `unverified`/`skipped` results (glm-5_3-flash says `fail` too) when `pr_caused=0`. Those turns now end as `ran`, and `test_review_loop_repair_that_erases_an_unverified_change_is_kept` pins this. The unchanged unreleased fragment changelog.d/9728-prepush-repair-passing-change-erased.md (lines 2 and 4) still promises a status-independent revert, so the two fragments contradict each other in the same release notes.
  WHY: There is no runtime code failure, but after the `@stable` sync consumers will read misleading release notes, and "Editor changes lost" can return on the `unverified`/`skipped` path. Reviewers rated it SEVERITY: NIT, mapped here to low; gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave no severity for this finding. Confidence was 4 from four reviewers and 3 from gemini-3_1-flash-lite.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

It should say the revert is restricted to `pass` and that `unverified`/`skipped` results with zero PR-caused failures end as `ran`.

  PROBLEM: The two unreleased changelog fragments contradict each other and the code. The base-branch #9728 guard reverted an erasing repair for any known status when `pr_caused` was 0. The new guard fires only for `pass`, so `unverified`/`skipped` with 0 PR-caused failures now ends as `repair=ran`, which `test_review_loop_repair_that_erases_an_unverified_change_is_kept` asserts. The new fragment calls this "behaves as before". The unchanged 9728 fragment still promises a revert whenever `pr_caused=0`. The agents.d/9728 fragment was updated, but neither changelog fragment was.
  WHY: No code fails, but consumer release notes after `@stable` will be wrong, and the path can end in "Editor changes lost". Suggested fix: reword the new fragment so only `pass` triggers the revert and `unverified`/`skipped` end as `ran`, and narrow lines 2 and 4 of the 9728 fragment to "status `pass` with `pr_caused=0`".

The base-branch #9728 guard reverted known statuses `("pass", "fail", "unverified", "skipped")` with `pr_caused == 0` using `reason=passing_change_erased`.   WHY: There is no runtime defect, but the release note is factually wrong. Consumers will think `unverified`/`skipped` repairs still revert, and "Editor changes lost (retry unavailable)" can return on that path. The unreleased changelog.d/9728-prepush-repair-passing-change-erased.md makes the contradiction visible. Suggested fix: scope the revert to `pass`, state that `unverified`/`skipped` end as `ran`, and align or drop the 9728 fragment.
